claim.ja: 零境界の特異な複素代数的klt n次元germ（n≥2）は正規化体積≤2(n−1)^n、等号は解析的ODP。K半安定Q-Fano多様体の大域上界も導く。
claim.en: A singular boundary-zero complex algebraic klt n-fold germ (n≥2) has normalized volume ≤2(n−1)^n, with equality iff analytic ODP; global bounds follow for K-semistable Q-Fano varieties.

role.ja: 四次元の基底から帰納。安定退化、stabilizerの二場合、同次元supremumによる評価を経て、等号を元のgermへ戻す。
role.en: Induct from the fourfold base through stable degeneration, two stabilizer regimes, and a same-dimensional supremum estimate; recover equality at the original germ.

claim.ja: 零境界の特異な複素代数的klt四次元germは正規化体積≤162、等号は解析的ODP。孤立性やlci性を仮定しない。
claim.en: A singular boundary-zero complex algebraic klt fourfold germ has normalized volume ≤162, with equality iff analytic ODP, without an isolatedness or lci assumption.

role.ja: 大きい体積から埋込み次元≤5を導く構造定理。terminal Gorenstein三次元切断と既知lci体積定理を経て、全次元論文の基底を供給。
role.en: Force embedding dimension ≤5 from large volume via a terminal Gorenstein threefold section and the established lci gap; supply the all-dimensional induction base.
